//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the DESC-TABLE CONTAINER — the Ant-Design-style `.pa-desc-table` descriptions grid (keen `PureAdmin.Components.DataDisplay.desc_table/1`, svelte `display/DescTable.svelte`). SCOPE = CONTAINER ONLY. The label/value cells are a SEPARATE sub-component (svelte DescTableItem; keen desc_label/1 + desc_value/1) fed through the parent's children slot, and BOTH dumpers pass slot content as plain ESCAPED TEXT (svelte textSnippet, keen text_slot) — so the cell markup can't flow through the harness. The body is a bare text token; per-cell element structure (pa-desc-table__label / __value / __value--full / __copy / copy-mode value states) is DEFERRED as acknowledged prose (no dedicated fragment fixture exists for the item). This fixture proves what the CONTAINER itself emits: the pa-desc-container wrapper, the pa-desc-table class, its eight layout modifiers, and the --label-width inline style. CONTAINER WRAPPER NOTE: keen's desc_table ALWAYS emits the outer <div class="pa-desc-container">; svelte's DescTable only emits it when hasContainerQuery is set. The goldens include the wrapper, and svelte's map carries an EXTRA hasContainerQuery=true flag (set in every scenario) so both wrappers agree on the wrapped shape — same absorbed-divergence treatment list.json gives keen's as=ul.

propsVocabulary.body: the table's cell area — filled with plain slot text in this container-only slice (real pa-desc-table__label/__value pairs are the deferred sub-component DescTableItem / desc_label+desc_value)
propsVocabulary.cols2: boolean — 2 label/value column pairs per row instead of the default 3 (pa-desc-table--cols-2)
propsVocabulary.fixed: boolean — fixed-width label columns (pa-desc-table--fixed); width from --label-width (default SCSS var)
propsVocabulary.labelWidth: custom label column width as a single CSS length (svelte labelWidth, keen label_width) — emitted as the inline style --label-width; invalid keen input is dropped. Typically paired with fixed.
propsVocabulary.middle: boolean — vertically center label + value cells (pa-desc-table--middle)
propsVocabulary.truncate: boolean — single-line ellipsis on labels + values (pa-desc-table--truncate)
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to pa-desc-table (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Structural only — desc-table adds no attribute conventions like button's type. The body slot is a plain text token (Body) so the diff checks the container wrapper + table tag + class + the --label-width inline style, not rich cell content. The outer pa-desc-container wrapper is present in every golden (keen always emits it; svelte emits it when hasContainerQuery is true, which its map forces on). labelWidth renders as style="--label-width: <len>" (no trailing semicolon from either wrapper); attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. The pa-desc-table BLOCK has exactly eight --* modifiers (cols-2, fixed, middle, label-end, label-center, value-end, value-center, truncate), all author-set container props; axis-1's block-modifier reverse-check is fully claimed by them. All pa-desc-table__* ELEMENT classes belong to the sub-component (cells), covered under `deferred` / `cssStateElements`. labelWidth produces an inline custom property, not a class. hasContainerQuery is NOT modeled as an oracle feature — it's an absorbed wrapper divergence (keen always wraps, svelte conditionally), carried only in svelte's map as an EXTRA flag.

labelWidth.note: inline --label-width custom property (style attr), not a class; paired with fixed

body.note: structural — the container's inner cell area; cell structure is the deferred sub-component

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

deferred.//: Per-CELL element classes of the pa-desc-table block — NOT container markup. They are emitted only by the DescTableItem (svelte) / desc_label+desc_value (keen) sub-component, which the harness feeds as PLAIN TEXT through the children slot, so no container golden can exercise them and there is no dedicated fragment fixture for the item. Acknowledged out-of-scope prose (unverified) — same container-only treatment list.json gives pa-list__item et al. __value--copied is JS-runtime state (see cssStateElements).
deferred.pa-desc-table__label: sub-component cell: the tinted label span (DescTableItem / desc_label)
deferred.pa-desc-table__value: sub-component cell: the value span (DescTableItem / desc_value)
deferred.pa-desc-table__value--full: sub-component value modifier: value spans all remaining columns (svelte full / keen is_full)
deferred.pa-desc-table__copy: sub-component copy button inside a copyable value (copy-btn / copy-hover modes)
deferred.pa-desc-table__value--copy-btn: sub-component value modifier: always-visible copy button layout
deferred.pa-desc-table__value--copy-hover: sub-component value modifier: copy button revealed on hover

cssStateElements.//: Element-level runtime state on the sub-component value cell — toggled by the copy-to-clipboard interaction, never hand-authored in SSR markup (svelte sets it from the `copied` $state after navigator.clipboard.writeText; it drives the 'Copied!' ::after). No feature produces it and no SSR golden exercises it.
cssStateElements.pa-desc-table__value--copied: copy-success state on the value cell, JS-toggled ~1.5s after a successful copy

scenarios.name: basic
scenarios.note: The blessed default container: pa-desc-container > pa-desc-table, no modifiers. Body is the plain slot token standing in for the deferred cell pairs. hasContainerQuery=true (every scenario) forces svelte to emit the wrapper keen always emits — it is NOT an oracle feature, only a svelte-map absorbed-divergence flag; keen's dumper warns-and-skips it harmlessly.

scenarios.name: fixed-label-width
scenarios.note: labelWidth drives the inline --label-width custom property (no trailing semicolon from either wrapper). Paired with fixed, as the SCSS --fixed track reads var(--label-width).

scenarios.name: combined

scenarios.note: Modifiers stack on one container (snippet's alignment+middle+truncate row). Class-token order is normalized away.
